description: LAN / direct-IP play over real UDP (D076): the game hosts from the lobby, a headless AI client (--net-bot) joins by address, the host starts the battle, and both run the same lockstep battle in real time. The host's peer compares state hashes with the client's every second: at tick 600 (30 s of game time, reached within 60 s of wall time) it has made 27 to 30 comparisons with no desync, and waited for the client's inputs on at most 20 polls. The bot sends no orders; client-to-host orders are covered by G4 lan_2v2_udp_loss5.
